nodes.label: React/React-DOM Peer Dependency Ignore Rule
nodes.rationale: react and react-dom are peerDependencies expressing an intentional dual-major support range (^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0), not pinned installs that need patching. Dependabot updates to peer ranges only widen or narrow that compatibility promise, a deliberate maintainer call. Bump peer ranges by hand when a new React major is actually adopted.

nodes.label: Node Version Policy (nvm use)
nodes.rationale: Repo pins Node via .nvmrc; always run `nvm use` before any commands to activate the correct version rather than hardcoding version paths or manipulating $PATH manually.

nodes.label: Non-Interactive Tool Guidance
nodes.rationale: Agents/CI must avoid commands that block indefinitely: use `pnpm test:unit --run` (omitting --run starts watch mode), `pnpm build:storybook` instead of `pnpm dev`, and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` to prevent interactive prompts.

nodes.label: Component Authorship Convention
nodes.rationale: Components live flat under src/components/ (no per-component subdirectories), colocated with .test.tsx and .stories.tsx; everything public is exported through src/index.ts; no default exports, to keep the public API surface explicit and discoverable.

nodes.label: Styling Convention (unstyled-by-default, structural CSS exception)
nodes.rationale: Components must be unstyled or accept className so consumers theme them; site-level theming is the consumer's job (see website/CLAUDE.md). Exception: ValuesCloud, SectionHeading, AccordionItem ship real structural CSS via a separate `./css` export subpath (registered in src/styles.ts) because their layout/spacing can't reasonably be left to every consumer; colours/fonts still read from --bl-* custom properties with fallbacks so it stays themable, and no Tailwind syntax is used since the package has no Tailwind pipeline.

nodes.label: Accessibility Convention
nodes.rationale: Use semantic HTML, add ARIA only where semantics are insufficient, and ensure all interactive elements are keyboard-navigable.

nodes.label: TypeScript Convention (strict, no any)
nodes.rationale: Strict mode, no `any`; prop types named ComponentNameProps and exported alongside the component for a consistent, type-safe public API.
